```{python}
#| label: setup
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML

from acme_eval import params
from acme_eval.claims import claim

BUSINESS = Path("data/synthetic_business.csv")  # SYNTHETIC: invented for teaching
claim("synthetic" in BUSINESS.name,
      "Every business figure in this update is labelled SYNTHETIC: it comes from the synthetic file.")
business = pd.read_csv(BUSINESS, dtype={"month": str}).set_index("month")
month = params.month(month, business.index)  # stops on a month that is not in the file

summary = json.loads(Path("outputs/summary.json").read_text())
metrics = pd.read_csv("outputs/metrics.csv")
value = metrics.pivot(index="metric", columns="version", values="value")
low = metrics.pivot(index="metric", columns="version", values="low")
high = metrics.pivot(index="metric", columns="version", values="high")

period = pd.Period(month, freq="M")
label = period.strftime("%B %Y")
previous = str(period - 1)
previous_label = (period - 1).strftime("%B %Y")
now = business.loc[month]
before = business.loc[previous] if previous in business.index else None

SYNTHETIC = "(synthetic)"
FIGURES = {  # column: (what it is, how it is printed)
    "customers": ("Paying customers (banks)", lambda v: f"{v:,.0f}"),
    "pilots": ("Banks in a pilot", lambda v: f"{v:,.0f}"),
    "monthly_recurring_revenue_gbp": ("Monthly recurring revenue", lambda v: f"£{v:,.0f}"),
    "calls_ranked": ("Contacts ranked",lambda v: f"{v:,.0f}"),
}


def change(column: str) -> str:
    """This month's figure, labelled synthetic, and its change on the month before."""
    _, show = FIGURES[column]
    text = f"{show(now[column])} {SYNTHETIC}"
    if before is None:
        return text
    word = params.direction(now[column], before[column])
    claim({"up": now[column] > before[column], "down": now[column] < before[column],
           "unchanged": now[column] == before[column]}[word],
          f"{FIGURES[column][0]} is {word} on {previous_label}.")
    if word == "unchanged":
        return f"{text}, unchanged from {previous_label}"
    return f"{text}, {word} from {show(before[column])} {SYNTHETIC} in {previous_label}"


def percent(share: float, digits: int = 1) -> str:
    """A share between 0 and 1, as a percentage."""
    return f"{100 * share:.{digits}f}%"
```

This update covers **`{python} label`** (month `{python} month`).

::: {.callout-warning}
## SYNTHETIC: invented for teaching

Acme Signals is a fictional company. Its business figures below (customers, pilots, revenue
and contacts ranked) are invented for teaching by `scripts/make_synthetic_business.py`; they
are not real company data. Each one is marked "(synthetic)".
:::

## The business

- **Paying customers** (banks): `{python} change("customers")`.
- **Pilots**: `{python} change("pilots")`.
- **Monthly recurring revenue**: `{python} change("monthly_recurring_revenue_gbp")`.
- **Contacts ranked** for customers and pilots: `{python} change("calls_ranked")`.

if before is not None:
    columns = {previous_label + " " + SYNTHETIC: [FIGURES[c][1](before[c]) for c in FIGURES],

## The model

::: {.callout-note}
## Real data

The model's figures are real: `scripts/evaluate.py` computes them on the public UCI Bank
Marketing data, `{python} f"{summary['test_rows']:,}"` contacts held out from training. The
company and its releases are fictional, and each release is measured by today's evaluation,
on the same held-out contacts.
:::

```{python}
#| output: asis
releases = sorted(summary["releases"], key=lambda r: r["month"])
live = [r for r in releases if r["month"] <= month]


def released(release: dict) -> str:
    return pd.Period(release["month"], freq="M").strftime("%B %Y")


if not live:
    claim(releases[0]["month"] > month, "No release was live in the month reported.")
    print(f"No release in `releases.yml` was live in {label}: the first, "
          f"**{releases[0]['version']}**, was released in {released(releases[0])}, so this "
          "month has no model figures.")
else:
    release = live[-1]
    v = release["version"]
    auc = {r["version"]: round(value.loc["roc_auc", r["version"]], 3) for r in live}
    if len(live) == 1:
        standing = "the first release"
    elif auc[v] == max(auc.values()):
        standing = "the best-ranking release so far"
    else:
        standing = f"not the best-ranking release so far ({max(auc, key=auc.get)} ranks better)"
    claim(standing.startswith("the first") == (len(live) == 1)
          and standing.startswith("the best") == (len(live) > 1 and all(
              auc[v] >= a for a in auc.values())),
          f"{v} is {standing}.")
    what = release["description"].rstrip(".")
    print(f"The release live in {label} was **{v}** ({what[0].lower() + what[1:]}), released "
          f"in {released(release)} and {standing}. Its ROC AUC is "
          f"{value.loc['roc_auc', v]:.3f} (95% interval "
          f"{low.loc['roc_auc', v]:.3f} to {high.loc['roc_auc', v]:.3f}), and calling the top "
          f"{percent(summary['top_share'], 0)} of its list reaches "
          f"{percent(value.loc['recall_top10', v])} of the subscribers, "
          f"{value.loc['lift_top10', v]:.1f} times as many per call as calling at random.")
    if release["month"] == month and len(live) > 1:
        old = live[-2]["version"]
        word = params.relation(auc[v], auc[old])
        claim({"above": auc[v] > auc[old], "below": auc[v] < auc[old],
               "level with": auc[v] == auc[old]}[word],
              f"The ROC AUC of {v} is {word} that of {old}.")
        print(f"\n\n{v} is new this month. It replaced {old}, and its ROC AUC, "
              f"{auc[v]:.3f}, is {word} the {auc[old]:.3f} of {old}.")
```
